text:
maria (PM): Heads-up: we're scoping an API for multi-step tool orchestration inside a single request. Customers want: deterministic ordering in some flows, best-effort speed in others, and clear billing/traceability. Need to pick primitives + defaults for the roadmap.

kevin (eng): Idea: expose 3 primitives that compose rather than modes: `order` (strict|soft|none), `hedge` (true|false) for speculative parallel calls, and `timebox_ms`. This gives surface area but keeps combinatorics manageable. Example: `order:soft, hedge:true, timebox_ms:5000` -> start all tools in parallel, accept first N ordered responses within 5s, fill gaps with fallback.

sanjay (infra): Composition is nice but watch resource blowups. Soft ordering means we must still keep per-invocation state until timebox expires. Add per-customer concurrency_quota and a per-request invocation_limit (default 8). Also require a short idempotency token for dedupe.

elaine (prodops): Agree on quotas. For hosted tier defaults: invocation_limit=6, timebox_ms=3000, hedge=false. Dedicated: more permissive but default to safe values. We also need SLA docs describing how partial=true responses look and how billing is attributed (per-invocation token cost + orchestration overhead).

olivia (design): From UX: chat flows must not surprise users. Recommend `order:strict` for chat tool-calls by default (so tools run sequentially, streaming preserved). For agent-like workflows allow `order:soft` + `hedge:true`. Need clear API naming: `orchestration:{order, hedge, timebox}` and one-liner examples in the quickstart.

nate (research): For ranking/embeddings mix: often we want to call embeddings for many candidates in parallel, then a reranker that depends on all embeddings. Pattern: two-phase pipeline: phase1 parallel embeddings, phase2 rerank (sequential). API should allow explicit phases or let server infer dependencies from a DAG. I prefer explicit phases in v1 to avoid complex graph scheduling.

kevin (eng): Agreed v1 should be linear phases array. Proposed request shape snip: 
```
POST /v1/pipeline/run
{
  "phases": [
    {"name":"embed_all","type":"parallel","tools":["embed-a","embed-b"],"timebox_ms":2000},
    {"name":"rerank","type":"sequential","tools":["reranker-v1"]}
  ],
  "trace_id": "<uuid>",
  "idempotency_token": "<token>"
}
```
Server semantics: start phase1, collect results until timebox or all done, materialize intermediate artifacts (short-lived), then run phase2. If phase1 partially fails, allow `partial=true` with provenance for each item.

sanjay (infra): Operational hooks required: per-phase metrics, per-tool retry counters, memory footprint estimate. Retries: use a request-level retry_budget that you allocate to failing tool calls. E.g., retry_budget=2 consumed across phases. Also distinguish retryable errors (429/5xx) vs non-retryable (4xx).

maria (PM): For prioritization: propose a staged rollout: alpha on Dedicated with phases-only API, measure mem/latency/cost at small, med, large parallelism. Launch criteria: safety (idempotency/dedupe), observability (per-tool spans), UX (docs + examples), and SLA story (billing + partial semantics). Q2 target if infra effort <= 8 weeks.

elaine (prodops): I'll write the gating checklist: canary % targets, tail-latency thresholds, memory headroom, and post-release playbook. Need a knob to disable hedging globally if abuse detected.

kevin (eng): I'll prototype the phases runner and a simple memory accounting model. Plan: prototype in 4 weeks, perf matrix by week 6. Also will add `retry_budget` and `invocation_limit` enforcement server-side.

olivia (design): I'll mock quickstart and two migration examples: chat->strict ordering, batch->phased pipeline. Also UX for partial responses: show `partial:true`, `missing_tools:[]`, and `provenance` per item.

nate (research): One extra ask: support streaming for sequential phases (so chat + tool outputs can stream back). For phased parallel steps, we can stream per-phase when results arrive but need strong ordering metadata.

deploy-bot: Spec draft uploaded -> <https://redwood-internal/docs/pipeline-phases-api|pipeline phases API draft> :page_with_curl:

maria (PM): Action items: kevin prototype, sanjay infra limits + metrics, elaine rollout + gating, olivia docs + examples, nate stream compatibility notes. I'll assemble a decision doc and slot on roadmap. Meeting in 10 days to review prototype. :spiral_calendar:
